name: aigitpilot
description: AI-powered commit messages using free models — Ollama, Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter. No paid API required.

commands.title: AI Git Pilot: Generate Commit Message
AI Git Pilot: Setup / Change Provider
AI Git Pilot: Install Global Git Hook
AI Git Pilot: Uninstall Global Git Hook

aigitpilot.provider.description: AI provider to use for generating commit messages.

aigitpilot.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model to use. Recommended: qwen2.5-coder:7b

aigitpilot.groqApiKey.markdownDescription: Plain-text fallback for the Groq API key. Prefer **AI Git Pilot: Setup / Change Provider**, which keeps the key in VS Code's secret storage. A key entered here is moved there automatically.

aigitpilot.groqModel.description: Groq model to use. Run the setup wizard to pick from the models Groq offers right now.

aigitpilot.geminiModel.description: Gemini model to use. gemini-flash-latest always points to the newest Flash model.

aigitpilot.geminiApiKey.markdownDescription: Plain-text fallback for the Gemini API key. Prefer **AI Git Pilot: Setup / Change Provider**, which keeps the key in VS Code's secret storage. A key entered here is moved there automatically.

aigitpilot.openrouterApiKey.markdownDescription: Plain-text fallback for the OpenRouter API key. Prefer **AI Git Pilot: Setup / Change Provider**, which keeps the key in VS Code's secret storage. A key entered here is moved there automatically.

aigitpilot.openrouterModel.description: OpenRouter model to use. openrouter/free routes to a free model that is available.

aigitpilot.customInstructions.description: Extra instructions for the AI. E.g. 'Always include the ticket number from the branch name'.

aigitpilot.maxDiffSize.description: Max diff characters sent to the AI. Larger diffs are cut down so every file still gets a share.

aigitpilot.excludeFiles.description: Glob patterns for files whose diff is not sent to the AI (they are still listed by name). A pattern without a slash matches in any folder.

aigitpilot.matchRepoStyle.description: Send the repository's last 10 commit subjects so messages match its scopes, ticket references and wording.

aigitpilot.globalHook.markdownDescription: Keep the global git hook and terminal integration in `~/.git-hooks` installed and up to date. Turning this off stops updates; run **AI Git Pilot: Uninstall Global Git Hook** to remove the files.

aigitpilot.terminalSuggestOnAdd.markdownDescription: In a terminal, offer an AI commit message right after `git add`. When off, the offer comes only with `git commit`.

aigitpilot.shellShortcuts.markdownDescription: Define the terminal shortcuts (`add`, `push`, `pull`, `s`, `log`, `co`, …) in interactive bash and zsh shells.
